heading: Four primitives, one orchestrated pipeline.
description: Helix is built on a small, well-defined set of primitives that compose into a fully autonomous coding workflow.

items.title: Atomic decomposition
items.description: Every prompt is split into small, reviewable units with explicit preconditions and a single goal each.

items.title: Dependency graph
items.description: Atoms run in parallel where independent and gate on their dependencies — exactly like a build graph.

items.title: Repo-aware verification
items.description: Each atom is checked against the rest of your repo: type-check, tests, lint, and contract assertions.

items.title: Reviewable PRs
items.description: Output is one or more small PRs you can actually review — never a 4,000-line sprawling diff.
